text: {"lessons":["A few months of price moves are not enough to reliably predict which way a stock will go; avoid trading just to react to short-term noise.","Buying more after prices have risen can increase my exposure at higher prices, so I should consider my overall allocation and cash before adding shares.","I have only made buys so far, so I should make future decisions deliberately and keep enough cash for flexibility rather than assuming every stock is worth adding to."]}
